explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/395: for unit complex z_1..z_n, is P(|Σ ε_i z_i| ≤ √2) ≫ 1/n with uniform random signs? Solved affirmatively by He–Juškevičius–Narayanan–Spiro. signedSumCount counts ±1 sign vectors with |Σ ε_i z_i| ≤ r, and the statement asserts a uniform c > 0 with count/2^n ≥ c/n for all n ≥ 1. Faithful.
